name: Diverse Mastery
body:
With your ability to learn quickly, you immediately gain knowledge in a number of different areas.

Prerequisite(s): Instant mastery (loremaster secret), Int 13

Benefit: When you take this feat you gain 4 skill ranks which you may spend on any skills. These skill points are in addition to any others you gain normally and are spent just like any other skill points. You may not put more ranks into any given skill than you are normally allowed.

Normal: Normally you gain skill points only from gaining levels or Hit Dice.
